title: Hybrid inference gatekeeper + prober: dynamic acceptance heuristics and in-flight graceful fallback
creator: Sophie Martinez
description: Goal: Add a lightweight gatekeeper component that makes per-request optimistic routing decisions into fast decode paths (quantized micro-batched kernels or reduced-attention variants) using short prefill probes. The gatekeeper should accept or reject the fast path based on a calibrated acceptance score computed from probe output + kernel/hardware fingerprints. When the gatekeeper rejects mid-flight, the system must be able to gracefully hand off to the full decode path without corrupting the KV cache or causing token duplication. This ticket scopes the runtime-side implementation, acceptance metric design, safety budget, telemetry, and an initial rollout experiment to validate tail-latency and quality trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper runtime hook that issues a max-3-token prefill probe and returns an acceptance_score within 2ms overhead for 95% of requests
Acceptance scoring function implemented and configurable via feature flags; default uses prefix_coherence (0..1) + kernel_fingerprint_penalty
In-flight handoff implemented: probe KV state reused when accepted; if rejected, subsequent full-path prefill continues from same request without observable duplication or hallucination regressions
End-to-end P95 latency for fast-path requests improves by >=12% compared to baseline in the controlled experiment with <2% increase in top-1 output regressions (as measured by evaluation harness)
Dashboard panels and traces show probe_count, acceptance_rate, false_accept_rate, fallback_rate, and avg/95/99 latency per route
Automated rollback flag and circuit-breaker when false_accept_rate > 3% or tail latency increases > 10% for 10m window
implementation_notes: Introduce Gatekeeper module in runtime routing layer with a pluggable Prober interface to support kernel-aware probes
Probe budget: default 3 tokens or 8ms GPU compute budget (configurable per deployment tier)
Acceptance score inputs: probe_logits_agreement, prefix_coherence_score, kernel_signature_compatibility, recent_per-route_fallthrough_rate
Kernel fingerprint table maintained by serving runtime to assign penalty for mismatch between probe kernel and target decode kernel
KV cache compatibility policy: if probe used reduced context compression, we must canonicalize cache entries before reuse; implement lightweight reconciliation layer

Fallback semantics: graceful fallthrough should abort the fast decode stream, flush partial outputs to client if already streamed (configurable), then resume from full-path decode with consistent offsets
Add conservatism window: newly rolled-out gatekeeper starts at 5% sampling, increases based on stability signals
Config exposed in control-plane for Dedicated/Private with per-tenant overrides and ability to pin acceptance thresholds
telemetry_and_metrics: gatekeeper.false_accept.rate (gauge) measured against offline eval set
rollout_plan: Phase 0: lab POC with synthetic workloads on dev cluster; validate KV reuse and handoff using unit tests and smoke harness
Phase 1: Canary at 1% traffic for non-critical routes (internal tools), collect acceptance/false_accept and latency metrics for 48h
Phase 2: Expand to 10% for customer routes with low regen sensitivity; run A/B with offline eval prompt-sets to detect quality drift
Phase 3: Gradual ramp to 50% with autoscaling of probe budget and threshold tuning; enable circuit-breakers and automatic rollback triggers
Phase 4: GA: expose per-tenant control and documented SLOs; add docs and SDK examples
notes_and_links: Related tickets: ENG-51234 (probe framework), ENG-42011 (fastpath kernel tuning)
